feature_request: Implement login rate limiting after 5 failed attempts
acceptance_criteria: The login endpoint returns HTTP 429 any time within a 10-minute window if the user has already had 5 consecutive failed login attempts
The account lockout remains active for 10 minutes after the 5th failed attempt, rejecting even correct credentials with HTTP 429 during this period
The counter for failed attempts resets immediately upon a successful login, allowing subsequent failed attempts to count from 1
The counter for failed attempts resets after the 10-minute lockout period expires, allowing the user to attempt logging in again
plan: Implement login rate limiting by tracking failed attempts in Redis with a 10-minute sliding window. The core logic will be added to `flaskbb/auth/services/authentication.py` to manage the counter, increment on failure, reset on success/expiration, and raise a `RateLimitExceeded` exception. This exception will be defined in `flaskbb/exceptions.py`. The view layer in `flaskbb/auth/views.py` will catch the exception and return an HTTP 429 response. Finally, a mock Redis connection and test cases will be added to `tests/unit/auth/test_rate_limit.py` to verify the behavior against the acceptance criteria.
